title: Quantstamp to Sponsor DeFi Talents Mentoring Program
summary: Quantstamp is pleased to sponsor the current cohort of DeFi Talents, a program for empowering talent for leadership in the decentralized finance space.
body_markdown:
Quantstamp is pleased to sponsor the current cohort of[DeFi Talents](https://my.defi-talents.io/) , a program for empowering talent for leadership in the decentralized finance space. Divided into three phases—basics, multi-disciplinary, and concentration—it is aimed towards ambitious, engaged innovators interested in a career path in DeFi, crypto assets and distributed ledger technology.


Over 18 weeks, participants will meet leading experts and industry professionals. In bi-weekly Zoom sessions, participants have a space to exchange knowledge and network with peers. The program admits 200 participants each cohort, with two cohorts each year, ultimately preparing 400 people each year for a career in the DeFi space.


“We are very excited to have gained Quantstamp as a partner for the DeFi Talents program,” says[Jong-Chan Chung](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jongchanchung/) . “This is a great match between a security leader within DeFi space and a program preparing people to enter the industry.”


Other partners of the DeFi Talents program include[Ledger Enterprise Solutions](https://enterprise.ledger.com/) ,[Blocksize Capital](https://blocksize-capital.com/) ,[Bankhaus Scheich (Tradias)](https://www.tradias.de/) ,[Algorand Foundation](https://algorand.foundation/) , and[Capgemini Invent](https://www.capgemini.com/service/invent/) .


Quantstamp is pleased to be involved in this mentoring program and facilitating the entry of more talent into DeFi careers.
